context.p: The provided sample JSON request body creates the motor log entries. A motor log entry has two filters. The user can:

li.p: To add a Comment, the JSON request body will be as follows:
"comment": "Investigate latest alert - WO#43 assigned to jane.doe@analog.com"
After passing this request body motor log entry details are added as a comment.
For more information on the path and header parameters, the request schema, and the responses, see Create a Motor Log Entry.

step.cmd: add a Comment to log a general comment to the motor log;
add a Repair to update the log to reflect that the motor has been repaired.
